description: Adds an email address or a whole domain to the trusted senders the business accepts email from, as Settings > Connections does: email_pattern is an address (name@domain.com) or a wildcard (*@domain.com), notes is optional. This filters inbound email; nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same entry.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_allowed_sender
title: Trust a sender for email sync
